end.parentNote: Ananya practised estimating collections, grouping in 10s, and deciding whether an estimate was close or far. They used 4 groups of 10 plus 5 loose objects to reach 45, but also returned to counting the groups as 9, so that mix-up was not yet corrected by the end. At home, use small groups of 10 objects and ask, “How many groups? How many objects altogether?” before checking the total.
